standard_prerequisites.name: Left exactness equals commuting with all finite limits
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: the definition of left exact in force (finite limits context) and lemma-limits-products-equalizers, cited at proof line 3525
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the implication (2) implies (1): a functor commuting with finite products and equalizers commutes with all finite limits.

standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of finite limits in A
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the standing hypothesis that all finite limits exist in A, so the displayed iterated fibre products exist.
